how: AFCD runs 41 designated campsites in country parks, free and first come first served, with tables, toilets and barbecue pits.

how: The 50 km Hong Kong Trail runs along Hong Kong Island's ridges from the Peak to Shek O, one of many marked country park trails.
The 100 km MacLehose Trail hosts ultra races such as the Hong Kong 100 and Oxfam Trailwalker, and the country park trails are used year-round by runners.
Designated trails at Chi Ma Wan on Lantau (with a new practice ground at Mui Wo) and others in country parks.
venue: Chi Ma Wan mountain bike trails

how: Trad, sport and bouldering routes on the Shek O sea cliffs, with a bigger sport-climbing crag at Tung Lung Chau reached by boat.
Hong Kong Birdwatching Society runs guided tours of the Mai Po wetland reserve; WWF also runs public eco-visits.
AFCD runs free weekend guided ecotours at Hoi Ha Wan Marine Park (two sessions of up to 25 people), plus a self-guided leaflet.
venue: Hoi Ha Wan Marine Park Visitor Centre

how: Corals can be viewed from the pier at low tide at Hoi Ha Wan, with guided ecotours on weekends; formal intertidal shore walks are limited.
The free, 24-hour Astropark in Sai Kung has naked-eye and telescope observation areas, run by the Hong Kong Space Museum.
No meteorite strewn fields or suitable desert terrain exist in Hong Kong; hunting means travelling to arid regions such as inland China or Australia.
Hong Kong has no natural snow; snow sculpture means travelling to northern China (Harbin) or Japan (Sapporo), several hours by air.

Dancetrinity runs salsa and bachata classes on a walk-in basis most nights.
Dancetrinity lists adult ballet classes among its walk-in programme.
Flaunt Studio teaches pole from beginner level through inverts and choreography; other studios exist in Cheung Sha Wan and Kwun Tong.
Weekly English-language open mic comedy nights at Bar 109, with other bars in Central also hosting open mics.
TakeOut Comedy Club has hosted improv shows, but a guide notes shows were limited to private or member events at the time of writing.

how: Garnish Music Production runs a turntablism course in small classes of up to four, taught by a Red Bull Thre3style champion.

venue: Hong Kong Arts School (Hong Kong Arts Centre)
